# Niramaya Physiotherapy (निरामयाः)

> Physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic at Life Republic, Jambe, Maharashtra. Single-page website available in English, Hindi and Marathi.

## Services
- Sports Injury Rehabilitation
- Back Pain Treatment
- Neck Pain Treatment
- Arthritis Management
- Post-Surgery Rehab
- Neurological Physiotherapy
- Pediatric Physiotherapy
- Geriatric Physiotherapy
- Dry Needling
- Manual Therapy
- Electrotherapy

## Page sections
- Home: introduction and consultation booking
- About Us: the clinic's approach (assess, treat, strengthen)
- Services: all eleven services
- Conditions Treated: spine and neck, shoulder and arm, hip, knee and foot, brain and nerves
- Testimonials: patient reviews and video stories
- Contact: enquiry form that opens WhatsApp, map and directions
